jobs.title: .NET developer
jobs.description:
Wil jij werken aan software die daadwerkelijk impact heeft in de fysieke wereld? Ben je een ervaren .NET Developer die energie krijgt van IoT, real-time data, cloud-native software en schaalbare systemen? Dan is dit een interessante kans.

Voor een innovatieve en snelgroeiende technologieorganisatie in de omgeving van Amersfoort, zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren .NET Developer.

Over de organisatie

Het bedrijf ontwikkelt innovatieve technologische oplossingen die bijdragen aan de veiligheid, monitoring en bescherming van waardevolle assets.

De technologie zorgt ervoor dat waardevolle assets kunnen worden gevolgd, beveiligd en indien nodig teruggevonden. Hierbij wordt gewerkt met een combinatie van IoT-hardware, firmware, cloudsoftware, mobiele applicaties en real-time data.

Als .NET developer kom je terecht in een technische omgeving waarin hardware en software nauw met elkaar samenwerken. Je werkt samen met engineers vanuit verschillende disciplines en hebt direct invloed op de verdere ontwikkeling van de producten.

Jouw rol

Als .NET Developer werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een schaalbaar IoT-platform.
Je bouwt mee aan moderne back-end systemen en gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces waarmee real-time data van een groot aantal verbonden apparaten wordt verwerkt en inzichtelijk gemaakt.

Je werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:
Ontwikkelen van schaalbare en cloud-native applicaties;
Bouwen van moderne back-end systemen met C# en .NET;
Verwerken van real-time data afkomstig van IoT-devices;
Ontwikkelen van API's en backend-functionaliteiten;
Visualiseren van data in dashboards en gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces;
Bouwen aan systemen die miljoenen connected devices kunnen ondersteunen;
Meedenken over architectuur en de keuze voor nieuwe technologieën.

De technische omgeving

Je werkt in een moderne Microsoft-omgeving met een sterke focus op schaalbaarheid, performance en cloud-native development.

Belangrijke technologieën zijn:
C#
.NET / .NET Core
Microsoft Azure
Azure Messaging Services
SQL en NoSQL databases
Serverless toepassingen
Containers
CI/CD
Test automation
Azure DevOps
Git

Aan de front-end wordt gewerkt met:
TypeScript / JavaScript
HTML
CSS
Vue
React
Angular

Wie zoeken wij?

Je bent een ervaren .NET developer die graag inhoudelijk wordt uitgedaagd en energie krijgt van complexe technische vraagstukken.

Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en vindt het leuk om je vast te bijten in nieuwe technologieën. Daarnaast durf je verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en denk je graag mee over hoe software en architectuur slimmer kunnen worden ingericht.

Wij zoeken iemand die beschikt over:
Minimaal 4 à 5 jaar ervaring met C# en .NET;
Ervaring met Microsoft-technologieën en Azure;
Kennis van moderne webtechnologieën zoals TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML en CSS;
Ervaring met één of meerdere frameworks zoals React, Vue of Angular;
Ervaring met SQL en/of NoSQL databases;
Kennis van serverless en containerized applications;
Ervaring met CI/CD en testautomatisering;
Kennis van SOLID-principes en software design patterns;
Ervaring met Azure DevOps en Git.

Daarnaast ben je communicatief vaardig en kun je complexe technische vraagstukken helder uitleggen aan collega's met verschillende technische achtergronden.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Je komt terecht bij een innovatieve en groeiende technologieorganisatie waar je veel ruimte krijgt om technisch mee te denken en daadwerkelijk impact te maken.

Je kunt rekenen op:
Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende techorganisatie;
Een brutosalaris tussen de €4.000,- - €6.000,- (op basis van 40 uur ex vakantiegeld);
Veel technische vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid;
Flexibele werktijden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden (2 dagen minimaal op kantoor);
Complexe technische uitdagingen rondom schaalbaarheid en real-time data;
Een dynamische en informele werkomgeving;
Een kantooromgeving in Amersfoort, goed bereikbaar met de auto, het OV en de fiets.

Ben jij toe aan de volgende stap ik je carrière en voldoe je aan bovenstaande eisen? Vind je het interessant klinken en wil je meer weten over deze vacature? Neem dan snel contact met mij op!

Ook indien je niet aan alle gestelde eisen voldoet kom ik graag met je in contact om de mogelijkheden te bespreken.

jobs.title: .NET Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

LORENZ Life Sciences Group is a leading provider of innovative software solutions dedicated to facilitating the secure and efficient digital exchange of data within the pharmaceutical industry. Our core mission is to accelerate the availability of vital medications and therapies to patients worldwide by streamlining the complex processes involved in drug approval and regulatory compliance. As an agile and forward-thinking organization, we pride ourselves on maintaining a flexible organizational structure that enables quick decision-making and fosters innovation. With a strong commitment to improving healthcare outcomes, we continuously seek talented professionals who share our passion for technological advancement and societal impact. Our international team and dynamic work environment provide an excellent platform for personal growth and professional development, making us a preferred employer in the health tech sector.

About The Role

We are actively seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer (m/w/d) to join our engineering team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining complex software solutions within the .NET ecosystem, primarily focusing on C# and .NET Core (including the latest .NET 10). You will play a key role in implementing high-performance REST APIs within microservice architectures, ensuring our solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with industry best practices. Your expertise will contribute to enhancing our existing systems and pioneering new features that support the digital transformation of regulatory processes. Collaboration is at the heart of our development culture, and you will work closely with other senior engineers, participate in code reviews, and contribute to technical mentoring and knowledge sharing. Your innovative mindset and passion for software craftsmanship will help us maintain our competitive edge and deliver value to our clients and end-users.

Qualifications

Multiple years of professional experience in software development with C#, .NET Core, and the entire .NET ecosystem.
Strong proficiency with relational databases such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL.
Hands-on experience with software architecture design, distributed systems, modern CI/CD pipelines, and containerization technologies.
Familiarity with agile methodologies like Scrum and Kanban, with a collaborative and knowledge-sharing approach.
Passion for software development, complemented by a structured working style and quick comprehension skills.
Fluent in both German and English, with excellent communication skills.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement modern software solutions using C# and .NET Core (including .NET 10), focusing on building robust REST APIs within microservice architectures.
Ensure high code quality through adherence to Clean Code principles, SOLID design patterns, and comprehensive testing strategies.
Conduct code reviews, provide technical mentorship to team members, and actively introduce innovative ideas, tools, and best practices to improve development processes.
Work extensively with relational databases such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, and PostgreSQL, and quickly adapt to new technologies as needed.
Engage in spontaneous brainstorming sessions with senior engineers to address real-world challenges, demonstrating problem-solving skills and proactive collaboration.

Benefits

Joining LORENZ Life Sciences Group offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal and professional growth. Enjoy flexible working hours and hybrid work options that allow you to balance work and life effectively. We provide an attractive starting holiday entitlement of 30 days, with additional days based on tenure, ensuring ample time for rest and rejuvenation. Our organization offers a secure employment environment within an owner-managed company with an international team, complemented by a competitive salary package ranging from 55,000 to 80,000 euros per year, and performance-based bonuses. We prioritize continuous learning and development, partnering with you to identify relevant training opportunities that foster your career advancement. Our modern Frankfurt office is equipped with the latest technology, a stylish workspace, and amenities such as a company parking lot with E-lades stations and the option to lease a company bike. We promote a vibrant company culture through regular events, a relaxed Duz culture, and activities like in-house yoga and communal meals, fostering a sense of community and teamwork.

Equal Opportunity

LORENZ Life Sciences Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives and experiences enrich our organization and contribute to our success. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or background. Our hiring process is fair and unbiased, and we strive to provide equal opportunities for growth and development to all employees. We are dedicated to fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to make meaningful contributions.

jobs.title: Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) – Cloud & Microservices / C# / .NET
jobs.description:
Tiere. Technologie. Zukunft

Sano steht für nachhaltige Tierernährung – von Mineralfutter und Kälbermilch bis zu Spezialprodukten für Rinder und Schweine. Unser Produktportfolio ist so vielfältig wie die Landwirtschaft selbst. Als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines Familienunternehmens mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit. Ein Unternehmen, das seit Jahrzehnten weiß, worauf es ankommt: gesunde Tiere, nachhaltige Prozesse – und IT, die das möglich macht.

Was dich erwartet? Kurze Entscheidungswege, ein Team mit echtem Antrieb und eine Branche, die Nachhaltigkeit nicht nur predigt, sondern lebt.

Hier bist du gefragt - deine Aufgaben

Als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) technische Verantwortung für unsere Plattform übernehmen und aktiv mitgestalten, wie unsere Software in Zukunft aufgebaut ist.
Sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team spannende Lösungen erarbeiten, die bereits heute in der Landwirtschaft eingesetzt und von dir kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.
Mit deinem Gespür für den richtigen Code Struktur in komplexe Systeme bringen, unsere Cloud-Plattform gestalten und dabei die langfristige Tragfähigkeit unserer Lösungen im Blick behalten.
Standards, Schnittstellen und technische Leitplanken definieren, neue Technologien bewerten und fundierte Architekturentscheidungen treffen.
Mit deinem Blick für das Wesentliche moderne Architekturansätze wie Microservices oder API-basierte Systeme sinnvoll einbringen.
Last, but not least beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer DevOps- und CI/CD-Strukturen supporten.

Das bringst du mit – dein Profil

Idealerweise eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit IT-Bezug – was zählt: Du brennst für IT und Softwarearchitektur
Ein Muss: Berufspraxis als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d), Solution Architect (m/w/d) oder Lead Developer (m/w/d)
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C# und .NET (Core/6/7/8)
Sehr gutes Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitekturen (Microservices, Event-Driven, API-Design, Messaging) sowie fundiertes Know-how in Security-Konzepten
Erfahrung in Cloud-Plattformen (AWS, Azure oder Google Cloud), in Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und in Datenplattformen, Datenbanken sowie IoT-Architekturen
Kenntnisse in DevOps, CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform, Bicep, GitOps) sowie Expertise im Monitoring, Logging und Tracing Spaß daran, technische Themen verständlich zu vermitteln und in (komplexen) Architekturen zu denken

Deine Vorteile bei Sano

Gute Arbeit, guter Verdienst: attraktives Gehaltspaket
Werkzeug, das begeistert: moderne Ausstattung für deinen Arbeitsalltag
Zeit für dich: 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr
Beruf trifft Leben: Flexible Modelle zur Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf – damit wir dich in jeder Lebensphase begleiten
Hier bist du richtig: ein zukunftssicheres Umfeld, das auf dich wartet
Rundum gut versorgt: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Krankenzusatzversicherung & betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Sattel auf, Zukunft an: Business Bike
Gemeinsam mehr erleben: besondere Teamevents, die verbinden
Kleine Aufmerksamkeiten, große Wirkung: spannende Mitarbeitergeschenke
Wissen, das wächst: die Sano Akademie – dein Ort für Entwicklung und Weiterbildung

Was du bei uns machst

Du verstehst dich als Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Entwicklung und Operations.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer with .NET and Angular
jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.

By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.

From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

In this role, you will work within a cross-functional product team responsible for modernising the user experience, backend services and cloud platform capabilities of one of WTW’s strategic cloud platforms.

You will contribute to a business-critical distributed compute platform that executes large-scale insurance modelling workloads across the organisation. The platform dynamically provisions Azure compute resources, runs computationally intensive jobs submitted by multiple business applications and provides a shared cloud foundation for analytical services.

The role combines frontend and backend development, cloud-native engineering and modern software engineering practices. You’ll help replace legacy technologies, rebuild AngularJS portals, modernise backend services, introduce Infrastructure as Code, migrate workloads to Azure Container Apps and improve deployment automation and operational resilience.

Working alongside experienced platform engineers, architects, product owners, DevOps engineers and QA specialists, you’ll help transform the current platform into a modern Azure-native platform while gaining deep knowledge of cloud platform engineering and distributed systems.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Contribute to meaningful modernisation outcomes across the platform and related services.
Deliver high-quality frontend and backend changes that are secure, maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve platform reliability, scalability and performance through well-tested engineering changes.
Apply agreed engineering standards, coding practices and review feedback consistently.
Support faster, more predictable delivery by contributing to automation, CI/CD and DevOps improvements.
Collaborate effectively with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and other engineers to solve delivery challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture.

Key Responsibilities

Application Development

Develop modern Angular applications replacing legacy AngularJS user and administration portals.
Design, develop and maintain .NET backend services supporting distributed compute workloads.
Build and enhance REST APIs consumed by multiple business applications.
Modernise legacy platform functionality while preserving business continuity.
Implement scalable, maintainable and secure software following modern engineering practices.

Platform Modernization

Participate in migration towards Azure Container Apps and containerised workloads.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to cloud-native platform modernization initiatives.
Participate in modernisation of deployment pipelines and release automation.
Help improve platform scalability, maintainability and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring software quality and reliability.
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
Apply Clean Code principles, modern software design patterns and engineering best practices.
Support continuous integration and continuous delivery initiatives.
Contribute to zero-downtime deployment improvements.

Operations & Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers and fellow Software Engineers.
Participate in production support and on-call rotation as part of the engineering team.
Contribute to troubleshooting, root cause analysis and continuous platform improvements.
Share knowledge and actively participate in building the engineering capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

4–6 years of commercial software development experience.
Strong experience with C#, modern .NET and ASP.NET.
Strong experience with Angular and TypeScript.
Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming and modern software engineering principles.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience working with Docker and containerised applications.
Understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles, with the ability and willingness to work with tools such as OpenTofu or Terraform.
Understanding of cloud-native application development principles.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing unit and integration tests.
Understanding of Clean Code principles and software design patterns.
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Ability to work within a collaborative cross-functional engineering team.

Soft Skills

Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Proactive approach to problem solving.
Willingness to learn modern cloud platform technologies.
Passion for continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Azure Container Apps
Azure Batch
OpenTofu or Terraform
Playwright
SQL Server
Redis
SignalR
Experience working on cloud-native platforms
Experience modernising legacy enterprise applications

Additional Information

“For this position, the gross base salary starts from PLN 15 267 PLN Gross per month
(full-time employment contract), determined using objective and gender-neutral criteria including skillset, experience and role responsibilities.

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. The figure represents the initial remuneration we expect to offer for this role and does not limit the right to equal pay for women and men performing the same work or work of equal value. All remuneration and benefits decisions are based on non-discriminatory, gender-neutral criteria, and in accordance with the Polish Labour Code amendments implementing Directive on pay transparency, we do not request or consider candidates’ current or past remuneration during the recruitment process.”

At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.description:
At ABB
, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Manager

__

Help shape the next generation of digital services at ABB Electrification Service Division. We are look-ing for a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems to unlock agentic AI capabilities across our digital port-folio and turn them into real customer value. In this role, you will help build intelligent systems that support customers in achieving their most important asset management goals: higher reliability, bet-ter predictability, greater availability, improved sustainability, and smarter lifecycle decisions. You will work at the intersection of AI, backend engineering, and enterprise integration to transform architec-tural designs into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.

ABB’s digital and service portfolio is increasingly focused on customer experience, comprehensive as-set management, digital enablement, and sustainability outcomes. This role is a key enabler for trans-lating that portfolio direction into intelligent products and workflows that help customers reduce downtime, improve maintenance decisions, optimize operations, and extend asset life.

As a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems, you will build, integrate, and operate production-grade AI agents and agentic workflows across ABB ELSE digital services. You will own the engineering required to move beyond pilots into secure, reliable, enterprise-ready solutions. This includes agent orchestra-tion, enterprise tool integration, evaluation, monitoring, control mechanisms, and operational excel-lence. The role also has an important team uplift dimension: you will mentor colleagues and help raise the internal bar in agentic AI engineering.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

Develop AI agents and multi-step workflows that support ELSE digital service and asset management use cases.
Turn solution designs into scalable, production-ready implementations across the ELSE landscape.
Connect agent workflows with enterprise platforms, operational data, APIs, and digital tools used in ELSE services.
Define effective patterns for tool use, context management, memory, orchestration, and workflow execution.
Create evaluation and validation approaches to ensure agent quality, safety, accuracy, and performance in real use cases.
Implement human approval flows, fallback mechanisms, and operational guardrails.
Ensure production readiness through testing, monitoring, deployment automation, and controlled releases.
Work closely with architects, product owners, data engineers, and software teams to deliver reliable, business-ready ELSE solutions.

Qualifications for the role :

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
7+ years of experience in software engineering, including designing and delivering enterprise-grade backend and cloud-based solutions.
2-3+ years of hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, LLM-integrated systems, or agent-based workflows in production environments.
Strong backend engineering skills, ideally in C#/.NET, with Python as a strong plus.
Strong experience with APIs, Git, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and secure enterprise integration.
Experience with agent evaluation, testing, verification, RAG, memory patterns, context man-agement, and agent control mechanisms.
Experience monitoring and optimizing AI systems for reliability, performance, and cost.
Understanding Microsoft enterprise security, compliance, and identity patterns, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams and mentor colleagues.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com
to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

You'll design data platforms and enterprise-scale data solutions on Azure, working across architecture, implementation and client needs. The role combines hands-on architectural work with close collaboration with implementation teams and stakeholders, from shaping the solution to supporting its delivery.

What you'll actually work on?

Gather requirements and translate business and technical needs into data platform architectures.
Design enterprise-scale Data Platforms, Data Warehouses, Data Lakehouses, ETL processes and Machine Learning solutions.
Identify where AI can add value within a data platform and help clients translate potential use cases into practical platform requirements.
Consider how data platforms should evolve to support AI-driven solutions, taking into account data availability, access, governance and scalability.
Define architecture across connectivity, authentication and authorization, CI/CD, data access, governance, scalability and cost management.
Work with clients on data strategy and help shape practical approaches to adopting and modernizing cloud data platforms.
Prepare cloud adoption roadmaps, project documentation, estimations and delivery timelines.
Support implementation teams from concept through delivery, providing architectural guidance and helping resolve complex technical challenges.
Stay close to evolving Data Platform and AI architecture patterns and assess how new capabilities can be applied to real project needs.

What you'll work with?

Azure | Databricks | Delta Lake | Delta Live Tables | Unity Catalog | Azure Data Factory | SQL | CI/CD | AI / ML

You'll work with Azure infrastructure and identity components, including VNETs and VMs, as well as Cloud Adoption Framework concepts across enterprise and data environments.

You'll probably enjoy working with us if...

You like turning complex business and technical requirements into architectures that teams can actually implement.
You're interested not only in building data platforms, but also in finding the right place for AI within them.
You enjoy exploring how AI can be supported by the underlying data, architecture and governance rather than treating it as a separate layer.
You enjoy working at both the strategic level and close to the technical details.
You are comfortable bringing different perspectives together and moving architectural decisions forward.
You can explain technical trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders, engineers and technology leaders.
You like taking ownership of difficult architectural questions rather than waiting for a predefined solution.
You keep an eye on how data platform and AI architecture is evolving and enjoy exploring what new capabilities can bring to projects.

This collaboration might not be for you if...

You're looking for one predictable project that will stay largely unchanged for the next few years.
You want to receive a finished specification, build exactly what's written there and move to the next topic.
You'd rather stay away from client conversations and collaboration with different stakeholders.

Elitmind is a consulting company.
Projects, clients, industries and technologies change. You'll collaborate with experienced people around you, but you'll also have a lot of freedom and responsibility for figuring out how to move your own area forward.

What collaboration with Elitmind looks like?

Help build Enterprise IQ

Build the Data & AI foundations behind more intelligent organizations, connecting data, analytics, AI and business context to turn technology into better decisions, smarter actions and measurable value.
Close to Microsoft

As one of Microsoft's key partners in Poland, we get early exposure to new technologies and solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem.
Strong Data & AI expertise

Collaborate with experienced Data & AI experts across different areas, technologies and enterprise projects.
Technology that keeps moving

Work across the Microsoft, Databricks and Snowflake ecosystems, with new technologies regularly explored and applied to real business challenges.
Different projects, different challenges

Our projects span different industries, technologies and business contexts, so there's always something new to solve.
Real autonomy

Take ownership of your scope and independently organize how you deliver the agreed outcomes.

Flexibility that works around your life

Choose where you work best and organize your working hours with flexibility. Work remotely or book a desk in our office whenever you want to collaborate or meet the team in person.

What we're looking for?

Strong practical knowledge of Azure and its data platform ecosystem.
Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Data Platforms, Data Warehouses, Data Lakehouses or Delta Lake solutions.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, including modern capabilities such as Delta Live Tables and Unity Catalog.
Good understanding of Azure infrastructure, networking and identity components.
Very good understanding of the Data perspective of the Cloud Adoption Framework and basic understanding of the Enterprise perspective.
Experience designing architecture covering connectivity, authentication, authorization, CI/CD, data access, governance, scalability and cost management.
Experience working directly with clients and different technical and business stakeholders.
Very good command of English.

Recruitment process

1. HR conversation

We talk about your experience, motivation and expectations, and give you the context you need to decide whether Elitmind makes sense for you.
2. Skills interview

You'll meet one of our experts and talk about your experience, previous projects and how you approach real problems relevant to the role.
3. Final conversation

You'll meet the person responsible for the area to talk about projects, expectations and mutual fit.

Whatever the outcome, you'll hear back from us. We provide feedback after our recruitment interviews because if you've invested your time in meeting us, you deserve to know where you stand.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with OAuth
jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Auth0
Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation Datadog
Playwright
Trivy
GitLeaks
Invicti
Experience building reusable developer platforms
Experience working with enterprise shared services

Additional Information

For this position, the gross base salary starts from PLN 19 267 PLN Gross per month (full-time employment contract), determined using objective and gender-neutral criteria including skillset, experience and role responsibilities.

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. The figure represents the initial remuneration we expect to offer for this role and does not limit the right to equal pay for women and men performing the same work or work of equal value. All remuneration and benefits decisions are based on non-discriminatory, gender-neutral criteria, and in accordance with the Polish Labour Code amendments implementing Directive on pay transparency, we do not request or consider candidates’ current or past remuneration during the recruitment process.”

jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer (Customer Identity) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

(Senior) Software Engineer (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in Tallinn, Berlin or Stockholm

In this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.

The Customer Identity Platform enables millions of consumers to securely use Riverty products, while providing seamless technical integration and frictionless user experience. Customer Identity Team is responsible for identifying or authenticating good consumers while recognizing and blocking bad actors to protect our consumers, merchants, partners, and Riverty from fraud.

On a daily basis you will

Design, develop, test, document, and operate robust, maintainable software for the Customer Identity Platform.
Participate in the end-to-end product development process and help the team ensure value, usability, feasibility, and viability.
Collaborate as needed with product managers, designers, architects, and other roles to discover the right solutions.
Monitor system health and application metrics for our live-critical platform. Investigate and resolve incidents as needed.
Identify issues, suggest improvements to new and existing features, and present ideas for solutions. Take initiative to improve quality across accessibility, performance, consistency, maintainability, and robustness.
Seek out, evaluate, and recommend new technologies and concepts, helping bring industry standards and best practices into our codebase and architecture.

Qualifications

You will be a strong fit if you have

At least 5 years of professional experience with .NET/C# development.
Strong expertise in RESTful APIs and backend service design.
Experience with microservices architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous/event-driven communication.
Solid knowledge of application and information security.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), and modern deployment practices; familiarity with Kubernetes, MongoDB, and Infrastructure as Code is a plus.
Hands-on experience with front-end technologies including TypeScript (React is a plus), or a strong willingness to work full-stack.
Openness to participating in on-call rotations.
Experience with identity and access management technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, Auth0, and PingOne AIC.

As a person you are

Self-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented.
Confident in communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
Fluent in English.
Empathetic, collaborative, and receptive to giving and receiving feedback.

Additional Information

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager till Hogia Redovisning & Revision
jobs.description:
Är du en tekniskt stark ledare som drivs av att utveckla både människor och teknik? Vill du leda ett kompetent utvecklingsteam samtidigt som du driver den tekniska utvecklingen mot moderna, molnbaserade lösningar? Hos Hogia Redovisning & Revision får du en nyckelroll där du kombinerar ledarskap, teknikstrategi och innovation med ett nära samarbete med verksamheten.

Om rollen

Som Engineering Manager har du det övergripande ansvaret för ett utvecklingsteam med ca 10 medarbetare bestående av utvecklare och testare. Ditt främsta fokus är att skapa förutsättningar för teamets framgång genom ett närvarande och utvecklande ledarskap, samtidigt som du leder den tekniska utvecklingen framåt.

Du ansvarar för att driva de strategiskt viktiga teknikfrågorna inom området och säkerställa en hållbar utveckling av våra produkter. Rollen innebär ett stort fokus på modernisering, automation och AI-drivna arbetssätt där du tillsammans med teamet identifierar möjligheter att effektivisera utveckling, kvalitetssäkring och leverans. Du följer aktivt utvecklingen inom teknikområdet, omvärldsbevakar och omsätter relevanta trender till konkreta initiativ som stärker både produkterna och arbetssätten.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att balansera förvaltningen av våra hybrida Core-produkter med den fortsatta utvecklingen av våra molnbaserade lösningar. Du arbetar nära produktledning, kravställare och andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa rätt tekniska vägval över tid.

Rollen är huvudsakligen strategisk och ledarskapsorienterad, men beroende på situation och behov kan du även bidra operativt i tekniska frågor eller utvecklingsarbete.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi tror att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande samt flera års erfarenhet av modern systemutveckling. Du har tidigare haft personalansvar eller lett utvecklingsteam och känner dig trygg i att kombinera ett coachande ledarskap med tekniskt beslutsfattande.

Du har erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmiljöer och molnbaserade lösningar samt ett intresse för hur automation och AI kan skapa effektivare utvecklingsprocesser och bättre produkter.

Vi arbetar bland annat med: C#, .NET Core, Microservices, Azure DevOps, Git, React, HTML/CSS, SQL, Cosmos DB, C++, MFC, XML

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga tekniker, men du har en bred teknisk förståelse och en vilja att fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med teamet.

Som person är du en trygg och prestigelös ledare som bygger engagemang, tydlighet och samarbete. Du är strukturerad och har förmågan att prioritera, skapa riktning och driva förändring även när flera initiativ pågår samtidigt. Du trivs med att arbeta långsiktigt, har ett genuint intresse för ny teknik och inspireras av att omsätta nya möjligheter till affärsnytta. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska och samarbetar naturligt med kollegor, chefer och externa samarbetspartners.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss bygger du lösningar som används av tusentals kunder och blir en viktig del av vår resa mot framtidens molnbaserade affärssystem. Du får möjlighet att påverka både teknikval, arbetssätt och teamets utveckling i en organisation som värdesätter innovation, kvalitet och långsiktighet.

Vi erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, en hälsosam balans mellan arbete och fritid samt attraktiva förmåner. Vi satsar på hälsa och erbjuder flera träningsaktiviteter, möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån ett par dagar i veckan och en arbetsmiljö där kompetensutveckling uppmuntras.

Hos Hogia får du en roll där ditt ledarskap och din tekniska förståelse blir avgörande för att forma framtidens produkter.

Tjänsten är placerad i Stenungsund med möjlighet till att arbeta två dagar i veckan på distans.

jobs.title: Data & AI Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Vilka är vi?

På Dyve hjälper vi ambitiösa organisationer att omsätta strategier och idéer inom verksamhet och teknik till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.
Dyve finns i Stockholm och Örnsköldsvik. Nu rekryterar vi till vårt kontor i Örnsköldsvik, där vi bygger ett team som förenar verksamhetsförståelse med arkitektur, data, AI och tekniskt genomförande. Hos oss får du arbeta nära kunderna, ta stort ansvar och vara med och forma hur vi växer.
Vi arbetar nyfiket och prestigelöst, med stark tilltro till vad vi kan åstadkomma tillsammans.

Vem är du?

Du kombinerar arkitektens helhetsperspektiv med en stark förmåga att omsätta idéer till fungerande lösningar.
Du kan förstå en verksamhets utmaningar, utforma en hållbar teknisk lösning och bidra aktivt till att ta den från idé till verklighet. Du trivs med att röra dig mellan kunddialoger, arkitekturfrågor och praktiskt genomförande.
Du kan förklara tekniska vägval för olika målgrupper och tycker om att samarbeta med andra för att skapa resultat som håller över tid.

Vad tar du med dig?

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av att utforma lösningsarkitektur och utveckla moderna data- och AI-lösningar. Du behöver inte ha haft titeln Data & AI Solution Architect tidigare, men du drivs av att kombinera teknik, verksamhetsförståelse och praktiskt genomförande.
Vi ser gärna att du har flera av följande erfarenheter:
Utformning av lösningsarkitektur, dataarkitektur eller molnarkitektur
Utveckling av AI-lösningar och intelligenta applikationer
Integration av AI-lösningar med befintliga system, data och arbetsflöden
Att ta tekniska lösningar från idé och prototyp till användning i verksamheten
Att väga samman funktion, säkerhet, skalbarhet och långsiktig förvaltning
Att samarbeta nära kunder och team med olika kompetenser

Du har sannolikt erfarenhet av moderna plattformar och verktyg inom moln, data och AI, exempelvis Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, Kubernetes eller OpenShift.
Du är nyfiken, tar ansvar och arbetar prestigelöst. Du uttrycker dig väl på både svenska och engelska.

Vad kommer du att göra?

Du hjälper våra kunder att identifiera möjligheter inom data och AI och omsätta dem i lösningar som skapar verkligt värde.
Det innebär att du arbetar med både arkitektur och lösningsdesign samt bidrar till att lösningarna blir genomförbara, används i verksamheten och skapar affärsnytta.
I ett uppdrag kan du exempelvis kartlägga behov och förutsättningar, utforma hur data, AI-tjänster och system ska samverka, bygga en första lösning och vidareutveckla den för användning i verksamheten.
Du arbetar tillsammans med konsulter, projektledare och teknikspecialister, nära både kundens verksamhet och tekniska team.
Du är också med och bygger Dyves team i Örnsköldsvik. Här får du möjlighet att påverka våra erbjudanden, vår tekniska kompetens och hur vi utvecklas framåt.

Varför Dyve?

Från idé till verklighet: Utforma lösningen och var med och förverkliga den
Inflytande på riktigt: Påverka både kunduppdrag och hur Dyve utvecklas
Delägarskap på sikt: Möjlighet att bli delägare och vara med på vår tillväxtresa
Breda team: Arbeta med kollegor som bidrar med olika perspektiv och kompetenser
Prestigelös kultur: Korta beslutsvägar, stort förtroende och stark laganda
Bra villkor: Konkurrenskraftig lön, bonus, tjänstepension, sjukvårdsförsäkring, friskvårdsbidrag och personalaktieprogram
Gemenskap: Konferenser, inspirationsresor och sociala aktiviteter

Vill du kombinera arkitektur, data och AI med möjligheten att bygga både lösningar, erbjudanden och ett växande team i Örnsköldsvik? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer or Software Architect to industrial domain projects
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of industrial digitalization? If yes, we have an interesting opening for you! We are currently looking for a Senior Software Developer or Software Architect to join our Intelligent Devices team and play a key role at the intersection of technology and business.

Manufacturing industries are living in an era of accelerated change and rapid demand for renewal. Industrial digitalization, green transition and recent volatility in economics are shaping the way organizations create value and interact with each other. The future of many traditional hardware businesses lies in software. Our mission is to help manufacturing businesses turn change into a competitive advantage with comprehensive digital expertise that combines technology, data and human insight. Our industry customer portfolio consists of large enterprises and corporations from asset intensive process industries to world-class intelligent equipment OEMs.

As our business is constantly growing, we are now recruiting new team members to our Intelligent Devices team. This team delivers various software solutions for our clients in industrial domain by creating solutions for intelligent devices such as drones, forest machinery and other industrial solutions. Projects may vary from web software development projects to Industrial IoT and Edge Computing projects. You can choose your preferred work location from any of the following locations: Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Lahti, Oulu, Tampere
or Turku
.

Your role as a Senior Software Developer

In this role, you will develop and maintain secure and scalable software solutions for our industrial customers. You will help translate customer needs into practical technical solutions and provide hands-on expertise throughout the project lifecycle—from early problem definition to implementation and continuous improvement.

As an experienced developer, you also take part in architectural decisions that ensure high-quality, reliable delivery at project level. You work closely with customers and teams, combining strong technical skills with a consultative approach to ensure solutions meet both business and technical goals. We will discuss the exact scope and focus of your role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, your monthly salary will range between 5200-6200€.

What we expect from you

Several years of relevant experience in middleware software development using some of the following technologies: Java/Kotlin, C#, TypeScript, Python, or Go.
Strong experience with public cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Previous experience in software development projects related to IoT, or Edge Computing.
You are a trusted advisor to customers: capable of communicating complex technical concepts clearly, challenging assumptions constructively, and guiding stakeholders towards technology decisions that align with business objectives and create long-term value.
Familiarity with key industrial technologies and platforms such as Azure IoT Hub, AWS IoT Core, Kubernetes, KubeEdge, OPC UA, MQTT, and Crosser is highly beneficial.
Interest in the opportunities enabled by artificial intelligence, along with practical experience using AI either in a professional or personal context.

Your Role as a Software Architect

As a Software Architect, your responsibilities include the design and development of software solutions as well as providing technical leadership to project teams. You will work closely with both customers and project teams to develop solutions that address customer needs. You will support, challenge, and guide customers in focusing on the right problems, with the goal of delivering maximum business value.

In addition to project work, you will have the opportunity to influence future projects by supporting sales activities as a technical expert. This includes assisting with proposal preparation, participating in customer meetings, and performing requirements definition and architecture design activities. We will discuss the exact scope and focus of your role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, your monthly salary will range between 5700-6700€.

In addition to the software development competencies above, we also expect you to:

Have experience working in a hands-on Software Architect role, with the ability to define and design the technical foundations and architecture of projects.
Act as a bridge between business and technology by translating customers’ business requirements into robust, sustainable technical solutions.
Have participated in pre-sales discussions with prospective and existing customers in the role of a technical expert, and be motivated to contribute as part of a team during proposal and tender processes.

Why join Solita?

This is an opportunity to work on demanding industrial software projects where modern software development meets real-world complexity. As Solita’s customer portfolio is versatile, you also have the opportunity to work in projects for other domains.
At Solita, we value expertise and give you room to make an impact. As a Senior Software Developer or Software Architect, you won’t just focus on implementation: you’ll also contribute to technical direction, architectural decisions, and collaboration with customers. Depending on your role and interests, you can deepen your hands-on technical work, take more architectural responsibility, and help shape the technologies and practices used in projects.
You’ll join a community of talented professionals who combine strong technical competence with a pragmatic, consultative way of working. We believe the best results are built together, through trust, knowledge sharing and a low-hierarchy culture where people genuinely support one another.
At the same time, we want work to be sustainable in the long run. That means opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth, flexibility in how your career develops, and a genuine respect for balance between work and free time.

Let's talk more!

If you want to join our growing and caring team of professionals, please send your free-form application today!
Our recruitment consists of two rounds of interviews where you will meet our team and learn more about working at Solita. You will be given the opportunity to show your skills and ask us questions. The purpose is to get to know each other better.
Any thoughts or questions, please reach out to our recruiter Essi Heino (essi.heino@solita.fi).

As a key technology, data, and design partner, Solita’s business is built on trust and responsibility. For this reason, the selected candidate’s identity and employment background will be verified. These checks are carried out in accordance with and within the limits of the Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life.

In addition, employment in this role may require a security clearance if requested by our customer. The security clearance is conducted in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance Act. Successful completion of the security clearance is required for the role.

jobs.description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

CCYC (Culture, Community and Youth Cluster) is a part of GovTech's Government Digital Transformation team where we support the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) and its statutory boards — such as the National Arts Council (NAC), People’s Association (PA), Sport Singapore (SportSG), and Islamic Religious Council of Singapore (MUIS)
— by delivering digital solutions that promote social cohesion, cultural vibrancy, and youth engagement.

[What you will be working on]

As a Software Engineer, You Will

Lead the design, development, and implementation of complex, scalable, and secure software applications across the full software development lifecycle.
Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to define requirements, architect solutions, and deliver high-quality products.
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code in various programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, C#).
Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and mentor junior engineers to foster a culture of technical excellence.
Troubleshoot and debug production issues, ensuring high availability and performance of critical systems.
Contribute to technical documentation, architectural diagrams, and best practices.
Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating their potential application within GovTech's ecosystem.
Participate in agile development processes, including stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

You're not just here to write code, but also to figure out what we should be building and how we should build it. You will work on meaningful projects that solve problems pertinent to our society. The public sector is full of opportunities where even the simplest software can have a big impact on people’s lives. Rather than work on commercial ventures commonly found in the startup scene, we're here to improve how we live as a society through what we can offer as a government.

Your job will be to bring expertise and capability to the public sector. Sometimes this means coding new systems from scratch. Other times this means using the best solutions the development community has to offer. We use cloud services, open-source software, and commodity hardware as far as possible. These often include, but are not limited to: GitHub, AWS, React Native, MongoDB, and Stripe amongst others. Knowing what to build and what to reuse lets us avoid wasting time on solved problems and focus on delivering actual value.

[What we are looking for]

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in software development with a strong track record of delivering successful projects
Experience in Mobile Application and Website Development, Content Management System (CMS)
Proficiency in at least two modern programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, C#) and experience with relevant frameworks.
Solid understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
Web development with Node.js background, preferably with Next.js and AI-assisted development
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical challenges and propose effective solutions.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
Experience working on government or public sector projects is a plus.
A strong passion for public service and leveraging technology for the betterment of society.
Overall, we look for people who have ability, initiative, good communication, and strong values.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.   

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. 

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. 

Please note that this will be a 2-year fixed term contract.

, defining the integrations, functions, and actions an automation can use so the generated prompt template selects the right function and populates its parameters from the request and connected data. The skill is in applying the LLM where it adds value while keeping flow logic explicit through designed nodes, branches, and decisions.
Own reference architectures, patterns, and standards for the Agentic AI platform
at expert level, translating each customer's context into the right design, judging which capabilities to apply for their environment, systems, constraints, and objectives, and curating proven, reusable patterns, flows, and components into a shared library the whole team designs and builds against.
Own the solution architecture for assigned accounts
, from solutioning through to live, supported production, engaging stakeholders directly to gather requirements, agree approach, and demonstrate value; owning design decisions and trade-offs and documenting them so the solution is defensible and maintainable; and overseeing build, deployment, and administration in the customer's environment, whether built personally or delivered with Engineers.
Map and integrate the customer's system landscape
, including systems of record (ITSM), identity directories, collaboration and productivity suites such as Microsoft 365, endpoint and digital-experience tooling, and CRM, ERP and HR systems, along with the data sources behind them, identifying the source of truth for each.
Work fluently across hosting topologies
, from public cloud (strong emphasis on Microsoft Azure) to private cloud, on-premises data centres, and hybrid combinations, and within the customer's network and connectivity boundaries.
Design identity and access integration
, connecting to the customer's identity provider for authentication, single sign-on, and federation with role-based, least-privilege access so automations act with auditable permissions and as the right user where needed.
Act as design authority
, deciding where each piece of logic and data should live, whether to use the platform, Azure, or a customer system for a given capability, and designing integrations resilient to the customer upgrading or replacing systems. Review the designs of Engineers, give clear technical direction, and keep solutions consistent with the team's reference architectures.
Raise the capability of the team
, mentoring Engineers, running design and code reviews, sharing reusable assets and good practice, and helping to evolve the way the CoE designs, builds, and delivers, all through influence rather than line management.
Use Microsoft Azure to complement and extend the platform
, filling gaps and fine-tuning where the platform alone is not sufficient. Apply Azure-native AI and agent services, in particular Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, its agent capabilities, model catalogue, and grounding and retrieval, both as an equivalent Agentic AI capability and a complement in Microsoft-heavy environments. Build supporting components (serverless functions, integration and workflow services, API gateways, event messaging) for orchestration, custom logic, and data preparation.
Evaluate capabilities and inform the technical roadmap
, assessing new Agentic AI and innovation features, Azure and Azure AI Foundry services, models, and emerging standards, running proofs of concept where useful; what to standardise on, and how the overall architecture should evolve.
Embed enterprise security throughout
, including zero-trust principles, secure handling of secrets and credentials, encryption in transit and at rest, PII masking, and content access controls per enterprise and regulatory requirements.
Test, deploy, and continuously improve
, with functional and reliability testing of real conversations and edge cases before production, promoting automations through development, test, and production environments under the customer's change process, and using analytics, unresolved-request review, and user feedback to increase automation and containment rates.

Required Skills and Experience:

Substantial hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI automations
or integrations on an enterprise conversational AI or agentic AI platform, or strong transferable experience in workflow automation and systems integration, with a track record of owning solution architecture, not only building to someone else's design. This includes designing agentic automations where a model selects and calls functions while the flow logic stays explicit and controlled.
Confident scripting for automation work
, in particular JavaScript, with strong JSON handling (parsing, building, and transforming payloads) and data mapping between systems using approaches such as JSON-path mapping and JOLT-style transformations.
Strong enterprise architecture experience
, with proven ability to design solutions across real customer environments: networks, servers, core enterprise services, and the mix of cloud, on-premises, and hybrid hosting most organisations run, Microsoft infrastructure prominent among them. Comfortable producing reference architectures and articulating design decisions and trade-offs to technical and senior audiences.
Experience integrating with enterprise business applications and systems of record
(ITSM and ticketing such as ServiceNow, CRM, ERP, HR, etc), including reading and writing to them and understanding their data models, permissions, and constraints.
Strong Microsoft Azure cloud expertise
: identity with Microsoft Entra ID, networking (virtual networks, network security groups, private endpoints, firewalls, hybrid connectivity), and core compute, integration, data, and AI services. This includes using Azure to complement and extend the Agentic AI platform capabilities.

working with Azure AI Foundry to build or ground agents and use its model catalogue, particularly in Microsoft-heavy environments.

: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication and authorisation flows, including OAuth 2.0 in its common grant types, with token lifecycle and refresh handling, JSON, and event or message-driven patterns. Comfortable onboarding third-party APIs, with exposure to integration and middleware platforms.
Experience deploying and operating integration components across hybrid and on-premises environments, including Windows-hosted services or containers with secure outbound connectivity to SaaS.
Experience delivering conversational chat and voice channels into environments such as Microsoft Teams, embedded web chat.
Practical LLM skills for enterprise use, including prompt engineering and prompt management, selecting and configuring hosted models, RAG and grounding in trusted data, intent classification and entity or value extraction, knowledge ontology and synonym tuning, and evaluating model quality and reliability.
Experience shaping, scoping, and estimating engagements
, running discovery with customers, advising on feasibility and approach, and supporting sales and pre-sales with solution outlines, architectures, and effort estimates that can be costed and committed to.
Technical leadership and mentoring
, acting as design authority, running design and code reviews, setting standards, and raising the capability of engineers through influence rather than formal line management.
A high degree of autonomy and ownership
, able to own architecture across multiple customer accounts in parallel, act as the senior technical point of escalation, and take responsibility for solution quality and outcomes.

Desirable:

Prior experience in a solution architect, technical lead, or principal engineer role, ideally in a consultancy, managed-service, or multi-customer delivery setting.
Experience with one or more leading agentic AI or conversational automation platforms like UiPath or AutomationAnywhere, with adaptability to transfer skills to a new toolset.
Experience delivering in regulated or enterprise environments where governance, auditability, and access control matter, including Microsoft-heavy estates.
Relevant Microsoft certifications, in particular Azure Solutions Architect, alongside Azure administration, Azure AI, identity, and security, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
Emerging agent-interoperability standards such as the MCP, A2A, etc.

jobs.title: Work Package Manager (Software Project Manager)
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.

We are looking for:

We are seeking a passionate and experienced Work Package Manager to join our biometric solutions team.

What you will do:

From secure software to biometrics and encryption, Digital Identity & Security (DIS Global Business Unit) technologies and services enable businesses and governments to authenticate identities and protect data so they stay safe and enable services in personal devices, connected objects, the cloud and in between.

In the context of IBS, there are several projects ongoing to be delivered to our customers and we are looking for a Software Work Package Manager to contribute to the successful delivery of our projects, a key role in our organization.

You will assign and schedule the engineering activities to meet the solution milestone.
You will collaborate closely with the Project Design Authority (PDA) and Integration Verification Validation and Qualification Manager (IVVQM).
You will challenge the proposed Design to better fit the project constraints, if necessary.
You will ensure that the projects are delivered on time and within workload by coordinating the sub-system level execution.
You will coordinate the lower sub-systems engineering teams to ensure compatibility and integrability of the solution.
You will identify, monitor and report the technical risks and related action plans.
You will be reporting to the Project Manager (PM) or Solution Engineering Manager (SEM) in schedule, progress, risks and workload.
You will be responsible for identifying and formalizing the work package requirements and scope with the appropriate support needed from the technical team.
You will be responsible for the work package requirements integrity and consistency throughout the project execution.
You will manage the sub-contractor and procurement technical assessment.
You collaborate with the customer on the technical aspects of the project execution.
You collaborate with the IVVQM to ensure verification and integration of the solution.
You will be structuring and mastering the delivery process, coordinating the teams, keeping right balance between time, costs and quality.

What you must have:

Technical background for at least 5 years (as software developer or quality engineer)
At least a first experience of 2 years in a technical management position
Facilitation skills to handle workshops with stakeholders to clarify requirements and scope
Knowledge of configuration and change management tools (e.g. JIRA)
Active contribution to communities (e.g. Project Management communities) and implement best practices
Experience in facing and mitigating risk, anticipating issues and creating opportunities.

What's in it for you:

Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit

We really welcome open-minded and committed people:

Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams

***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.

#LI-AE2

Job Description

Development is the largest discipline at Endava. Our developers design, build, and release software products in multiple programming languages, frameworks, and libraries. Always collaborating with cross-functional project teams, our developers are adaptable problem-solvers with a client-oriented mindset.

As a Senior .NET Developer at Endava you will develop innovative products and cloud solutions to tackle a wide variety of problems. You will act as a key contributor to system design and architecture to achieve high impact outcomes.

Responsibilities:

Designs, estimates, and implements technical solutions for medium/high complexity applications.
Participates actively in all phases of the application development lifecycle.
Collaborates with various project stakeholders to provide support for clarifying requirements, processes, architecture, and priorities.
Recommends and promotes IT industry standards, tools, and practices (DevOps, etc.) to achieve well-engineered software products.
Proposes improvements and escalates risks/issues related to development activities.
Participates in the review of the work done by development team members.
Learns and applies new technologies, practices, and tools as appropriate to the project.
Participates in internal and external tech communities, events, etc.
Shares experience and knowledge gained from projects.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in software development.
Strong understanding of different common programing paradigms (OOP, Functional, etc.).
Strong familiarity with design/architectural patterns and clean code principles(e.g. SOLID, GoF, MVVM) .
Proficient in relevant programming languages, frameworks and tools such as C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET, Entity Framework, LINQ, Visual Studio,, Azure Fundamentals. Nice to have:
other cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.
Practical experience in platform specific database systems and SQL.
Good understanding of version control systems like Git or similar
Solid experience with testing and mocking frameworks
Familiar with common communication protocols and standards such as HTTP, REST, JSON, TCP/IP and others.
Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g., SCRUM, KANBAN).
Knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices
Good problem-solving skills and analytical thinking.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
Upper-Intermediate English proficiency.

Additional Information

Competitive salary package, share plan, company performance bonuses, value-based recognition awards, referral bonus;

Career coaching, global career opportunities, non-linear career paths, internal development programmes for management and technical leadership;

:
